content.comment_body: Hello. I have a [product_name] [article_no], but when I connect it to my PC, the [product_name] software does not detect it. In the tools-select hardware menu, it shows up in grey and cannot be selected. Is this device compatible with the latest version of [product_name] software, or do I need to use an earlier version? Thank you in advance.

Hi, It seems your project uses function blocks that aren't supported by the [product_name] [article_no]. Try starting a new project in the [product_name] software, then switch to [product_name] [article_no]. This should work, and you can check which instructions are compatible. If I recall correctly, [product_name] [article_no] doesn't support AND, OR, etc., with four inputs—only three are allowed for these instructions. Other function blocks may also differ. Hope this helps.

analysis.insight_summary: Users report issues with compatibility and device recognition between the [product_name] [article_no] hardware and the latest version of [product_name] software. The device appears greyed out in the software menu, indicating either unsupported hardware or mismatched versions. Users are also uncertain about which function blocks and instructions the device supports.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects the [product_name] [article_no] hardware to be fully recognized and functional in all versions of [product_name] software, wishing to use the device without encountering compatibility problems.
